verdict.rationale: Adyen is a payments platform and API provider, not an AI agent or host application that consumes tools, so plugging in external MCP servers is a category error for this product type. The evidence shows Adyen only in the MCP server role (an official local MCP server exposing Adyen APIs to LLM clients), which is the opposite role and cannot be credited to this client-side story. Nothing in the pack shows Adyen acting as an MCP client.
